source_scope: R4 fold0 admitted TRAIN and INNER sources only; old OUTER/calibration/domain/sealed excluded
source_protocol: new source-block early-stop split plus separate sensor-group holdout; 24h SA support purge

new_generator.snr_definition: full transformed reference trajectory peak-minute broadband power BEFORE window crop/masking relative to background median observed-minute broadband power; never renormalize an outside-CPA tail
new_generator.zero_fraction_semantics: explicit no-source requests; observed y-zero can be greater when a source meets only unobserved cells

neural.score_policy: fixed .5*predicted_share+.5*observed temporal q-mask contrast over nominal316..5012Hz; derived logit, no free presence head

tree.score_policy: fixed .5*share+.5*TRAIN-fitted presence probability; also report each AUC

checkpoint_selection: source-isolated same-sensor INNER site-macro RMSE under each arm's own R4/R6 generator; also report window RMSE. Compare arms on common frozen heldout panels, not different INNER target populations.
heldout_policy: cross-generator and cross-sensor panels evaluated only after every arm checkpoint is frozen; no tuning, ranking-based retries or ensemble fitting on these panels
site_sampling: equal-site TRAIN primary draws, then deterministic within-site shuffle/cycling; no Test site proportions
pilot_limit: Small CPU ablation, not full 5-fold production, original WideCNN reproduction, task SOTA or official-LB forecast

hard_negatives.definition: TRAIN LF bump >= pooled TRAIN q90 and LF bump > max(safe_MF,HIGH bump)+3dB; not verified natural vessel absence

readiness: all numerical and source gates required; still no actual model fit has begun
